text:
Priya Shah: Hey everyone — I'm Priya, started yesterday in product. Quick access question: I can see some GCP projects but not the EU ones we need for testing. Also trying to access the org billing for AWS (can't link billing account). Who should I ping to get the right roles?
Sam Foley: welcome! do you have the project ids and the aws account id? we'll need those to attach roles.
Priya Shah: Thanks Sam. GCP project ids: redwood-eu-dev, redwood-eu-tests. AWS account id: 123456789012. I think I need storage.admin on the GCP projects and Billing Account User on the org billing? Not 100% sure.
June Liu: @Priya Shah for GCP EU projects you likely need roles/storage.admin and roles/compute.viewer to run the test infra. For billing, we usually add users to the 'redwood-billing-access' group which gives Billing Account Viewer.
Priya Shah: ok, how do I request the billing group? is there a self-serve form?
June Liu: yes — file a ticket via the portal and include aws account id + reason. copy this template: "Request: add Priya Shah (priya@redwood.ai) to redwood-billing-access for account 123456789012 — reason: running EU infra tests". I'll approve once it's in the queue.
Priya Shah: copying template. do you need my GCP IAM email? priya@redwood.ai
Sam Foley: perfect. i'll start the GCP role grant — can you run this command and paste output so i can verify?
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-tests --flatten="bindings[]" --format="table(bindings.role, bindings.members)"
```
Priya Shah: ran it, output attached (small snippet):
```
ROLE: roles/viewer
MEMBERS: user:priya@redwood.ai
```
Sam Foley: cool — looks like viewer only. i'll add storage.admin and compute.viewer. june, can you kick off the billing ticket? i'll assign the GCP change to infra oncall.
June Liu: filing now. pinging platform-oncall to check org-level enrollment.
Platform Oncall: Thanks for the tag. I've created ticket INF-1029 to link aws account 123456789012 to redwood-billing. Estimated SLA 2 business days. I've also added Priya to the temporary billing access group for review.
Cloud Onboard Bot: access-ticket created: INF-1029 — assignee: platform-oncall — <https://go.redwood/tickets/INF-1029>
Priya Shah: amazing, thanks all! hungry — gonna grab lunch but will check back later. :wave:
Sam Foley: welcome again! ping here if anything blocks.
June Liu: also FYI for EU projects we sometimes need a separate quota request, ping me if you hit quota limits. :thumbsup:
